title: Expose Control prepare-edit boundary and native source truth
summary: Extend the HumbleStudio localhost connection manifest with a no-write prepare-edit contract, missing-export recovery metadata, native supported-app source truth, and a documented edit boundary for future HumbleControl convergence.
acceptance_criteria: The HumbleControl connection manifest exposes an editBoundary object that keeps writes disabled and apply locked.
A read-only `/api/connections/humble-control/prepare-edit` endpoint returns proposal/session source truth without mutating repositories.
Export descriptors include missing-export state and a prepare-edit URL.
The native supported-app catalog carries source kind, local export path, read-only mode, prepare-edit mode, write lock, and stable session id metadata.
New native user-facing text is routed through StudioStrings and Localizable.xcstrings.
A docs decision records that prepare-edit is allowed only as no-write planning while apply remains locked.
Local helper tests, web fallback checks, workflow checks, and practical native verification pass or blocked commands are documented honestly.

evidence.note: Added editBoundary metadata to the HumbleControl manifest and a no-write prepare-edit contract endpoint.
Added native supported-app source truth for source kind, local export path, read-only mode, prepare-edit mode, write lock, and session id.
Recorded the first Control/Studio edit-boundary decision: prepare-edit may plan, apply remains locked.
Local preview helper tests passed for 10 tests.
Static web fallback verification passed and now guards the prepare-edit schema and capabilities.
Native macOS build succeeded after adding catalog source truth and localized lock text.
Lane preview manifest returned editBoundary, prepare-edit capability, session-source-truth capability, and missingExport metadata.
Lane preview prepare-edit endpoint returned schema humble.studio.prepare-edit.v1 with writes:false and locked apply boundary.
